checkpoints.label: September checkpoint
checkpoints.question: Has threshold moved? (HR at 4:40 in a clean 4×6 + full-month EF trend, all runs, all conditions)
checkpoints.outcome: Easy paces re-priced down; threshold band held. Month-long easy EF rose 1.039 → 1.055 (1.060 on runs ≥8 km), with the trend climbing inside the month: 1.022 (Aug 12–20) → 1.063 (Aug 26–Sep 1) → 1.121 (Sep 3–9). Threshold cost fell sharply across the three 4×6s (RE 129 → 123 → 100) at held pace and in slower shoes, but HR at 4:40 is still ~179 vs LTHR 177 — short of the 175–176 criterion, so the band stays. Suspicion: LTHR may itself have drifted up; the Nov 1 10K will give a free, more accurate LTHR estimate.
